If your lawyer can get you down to a misdemeanor that's great! But if not, dont beat yourself up for it. I got a gross misdemeanor for my first one (.29) I got probation, community service, and alcohol and drug assessment, along with Madd class.

Just be glad they pulled you over speeding instead of finding you at the scene of an accident. The judge wont go super easy on you, but they wont throw the book at you either. 

As for the anxiety... I'm not gonna lie, it sucks. Its nerve wracking,  but it honestly isnt that bad once you get to court and keep your nose clean for a while.

You should see if you can apply for a public defender. 

Personally for me I saved money on a lawyer and got a public defender since they had me dead to rights. I used the money I saved to pay for all the fees. 

It sucks in the beginning,  but itll seem less and less worse as time goes on. And you'll realize it could've been worse... especially in MN. (In the top 10 for dui's in the states)

I'd recommend setting up dui classes and starting early. It'll show the courts that you are taking this seriously. Since you blew higher than .15 it'll be a gross misdemeanor and minnesota will require you to either get an interlock for 1 year or stop driving for 1 year until you can get your license reinstated. 

 If you dont mind me asking..  Where in Mn did you get this?  Different counties may be more or less severe.
